meta.title: Buying fish from Egypt: how importers order
meta.description: Fresh fish from Egypt for importers and distributors: 12 species, weight grades, packing on ice, 7+ markets and how to reach AZAFCO International.

hero.title: Start a fresh fish supply partnership
hero.intro: We pack up to 2,500 t/month at our plant in Motobas. A refrigerated truck carries 20 t, and on some days more than five leave the plant.
hero.image_alt: Whole fresh sea bream, sea bass and tilapia on crushed ice under cool light

grades.q: Which weight grades can you supply?
grades.a: Our indicative grades: {grades}. For the other species, tell us the weight you need.

packing.q: How is the fish packed and shipped?
packing.a: Whole and fresh chilled, on ice in EPS foam boxes. Our own refrigerated trucks take it from the plant, then it goes by air or road.

markets.q: Which markets do you ship to?
markets.a: We ship to 7+ markets, including the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Lebanon, Qatar, Iraq and Syria. We are approved for export to the European Union; Russia and the USA are in our plan.

fraud.q: How do we know a message is really from AZAFCO International?
fraud.a: We only write from business@azafco.com.eg and from WhatsApp +20 100 773 6419, so check any message from another address or number with us before you act on it.
